sources.title: Arthroceras
sources.clean:
{{for|the plant genus|Arthroceras subterminale}}

Arthroceras is a genus of snipe flies in the family Rhagionidae. Species of the genus Arthroceras are mid-sized to large {{convert|4.5|to|13|mm}}, black, grey, or yellowish-colored flies that have a fairly long, tapering antenna consisting of 5–8 flagellomeres. Within the family Rhagonidae, some authorities place the genus in the subfamily Arthrocerinae, in which it is the only genus.
